text: ILLUMINATED EXTERIORS Our Work How It Works FAQ About Free Design Call 402-699-6256 Serving Omaha, Elkhorn and homes within about 50 miles. HOW IT WORKS One install. Every night after. A track that matches your trim, lights you control one by one, and an app that runs the schedule for you. Here’s how the pieces fit. 01 · THE TRACK Hidden in your trim. A trim-matched aluminum channel runs along your roofline and stays out of sight by day. Ask us to bring a sample to your free design so you can see the track against your own trim. 02 · THE LIGHTS Every light, its own color. Individually controllable LED lights give you soft warm white on an ordinary night and full color when the occasion calls for it. At your free design we’ll show you the colors on your own house before you decide. 1:00 PM 6:46 PM ↔ DAYTIME · THE TRACK DISAPPEARS INTO YOUR TRIM THE LIGHT Built to stay up for good. Each light sits in a slim channel matched to your trim, so it disappears by day and shines evenly by night. 03 · THE APP Scenes, schedules, zones. Pick a scene, set it to run at sunset, and split the house into zones, all from your phone. On install day we set up the app with you and program your first scenes. ZONES Light one section or the whole house. Front porch only, the whole roofline, or anything in between. Each zone runs on its own schedule. 04 · THE WARRANTY 12 months of coverage. Your system comes with a 12-month warranty. At your free design visit we’ll walk you through exactly what it covers, in writing. PRICING How pricing works Every home is quoted on three things: the length of your roofline, the number of stories, and the controller and zones you choose. A free design visit gets you an exact number for your house. Start my free design ILLUMINATED EXTERIORS Permanent roofline lighting for homes in Omaha, Elkhorn and within about 50 miles.
